Chapter 376: Chapter 3 Seventh-Level Citizen (Subscribe please)

Chikun Main Star, Central Continent.

Thirteen Peaks.

From the outside, this peak looked no different from usual.

But in reality, this area had already been isolated by the Chikun Star Lord using some method, and had been ‘stripped’ from the original Chikun Main Star.

With the power of the Chikun Star Lord, carrying out these actions went unnoticed by any of the Evolvers on the main star.

And all the Evolvers within the isolated area had fallen into a deep slumber, unable to sense the vast changes in the outside world.

...

Boom.

The surging forces of the World and Space continued unabated.

The huge world illusion continued to expand rapidly, showing no signs of stopping even after reaching over a hundred thousand li.

The Chikun Star Lord stood alone in the void, silently watching the world illusion above.

Exaggerated.

It was indeed too exaggerated.

The Chikun Star Lord originally had high expectations for Lin Yuan.

He thought that his clever disciple, before reaching the peak of the Seventh Rank, might be able to forge an Inner World of about three to five li in radius?

But what about the reality?

The world illusion now was nearly a hundred and ten thousand li.

How could it differ by tens of thousands of times compared to before?

An Inner World with a radius of a hundred and ten thousand li meant little to the Chikun Star Lord.

The Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, a pinnacle lineage of cosmic bloodline, nurtured a small world within it from birth, and once it reached the Sixth Rank as an adult, the Inner World could easily be several tens of li.

Upon advancing to the Seventh Rank, the Inner World would directly expand to several tens of thousands of li.

Upon freshly advancing to the Eighth Rank, Chikun Star Lord’s Inner World had surpassed a million li.

But these were the Starry Sky Wanderer Kuns, the ‘favorites’ of the cosmic space origin, born with their own small worlds, a part of their innate talents.

What about Lin Yuan?

He was merely a human who, at the Seventh Rank, had managed to nurture an Inner World surpassing a hundred thousand li. This was simply…

The thoughts of the Chikun Star Lord fluctuated.

Are you the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, or am I?

“The size of the Inner World primarily depends on the understanding of the Space Rules…”

The Chikun Star Lord thought to himself.

The reason why Starry Sky Wanderer Kuns come with their own Inner Worlds is because these special beings begin to understand the Space Rules from birth, comprehending nine hundred and sixty-five basic spatial models.

Additionally, some core spatial models are also on the verge of being fully comprehended, this is a huge advantage of being a ‘favorite’ of the cosmic space origin.

Even when compared with cosmic rarities like the ‘World Fruit,’ and other forces forcibly forging an Inner World.

The size of the initial Inner World could only be a few hundred to a thousand li at most.

After that, if one wants to further expand the Inner World, they must advance in their comprehension of the Space Rules.

Lin Yuan’s Inner World now being at least a hundred thousand li was something no cosmic rarity can achieve, it could only be accomplished through one’s own accumulation in the Space Rules.

“An Inner World with a radius of a hundred thousand li, at least a thousand core Space Rules must be comprehended to achieve such a feat… My disciple, didn’t he just comprehend the basic spatial models recently…”

The Chikun Star Lord suddenly felt a sense of powerlessness.

Lin Yuan’s talent and comprehension were terrifyingly impressive. How long had passed, and he had achieved such accomplishments in the core spatial models?

“Under a hundred years old, comprehending a thousand core Space Rules, this can only be achieved by that handful of people even in the entire Cosmic Human Alliance…”

“If starting from scratch, not using any external objects…..”

“I estimate no Evolver genius of the contemporary age could compare with my disciple…”

The Chikun Star Lord thought silently to himself.

In the Central Star Domain and some other powerful star domains, genius Evolvers have a high starting point, receiving numerous resources even before birth.

Or like the Chikun Star Lord himself, who seized the body of some terrifyingly talented special being, instantly elevating his starting point immensely.

Many fortuitous encounters.

Many resources funneled their way.

Barely managed to create some Evolver geniuses comparable to Lin Yuan of the current era.

If one were to disregard those fortuitous encounters and the funneling of resources, Lin Yuan’s natural talent would definitely be unmatched among the young generation of Human Civilization.

“The expansion speed of the world illusion has slowed down…”

The Chikun Star Lord felt a slight relief. An Inner World exceeding a hundred thousand li in radius was nearly approaching the Inner World of an Evolver at the peak of the Eighth Rank.

…

Deep within the grand hall.

With each breath Lin Yuan took, the power of the world overflowed.

“It finally stopped…”

Lin Yuan, conscious within his Inner World, looked at the vast world spanning a hundred and twenty thousand li in radius, a smile forming on his face.

Compared to the small world of ten li radius previously, the current world of a hundred and twenty thousand li radius was almost equivalent to the size of over ten Canglan Stars.

“I can feel that the Inner World could still expand a bit more, but due to the limitations of the physical soul, it stopped at a hundred and twenty thousand li…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The size of an Evolver’s Inner World mainly depends on two aspects.

One is the individual’s physical soul, which is the foundation that carries the Inner World; if the physical soul is too weak, no matter how high one’s spatial comprehension is, the Inner World cannot expand very much.

Lin Yuan, whose path of Martial Dao evolution emphasized the body and whose soul had transformed into a Primordial Spirit, was equally powerful, thereby enabling him to sustain an Inner World of a hundred and twenty thousand li in radius.

The second is the comprehension of space.

Now, Lin Yuan distinctly felt that his understanding of space had exceeded the limits of the physical body.

“It doesn’t matter much.”

“Such a vast Inner World, nurturing the Power of the World, virtually enhances my physical soul every moment…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, feeling the world’s power flowing through him like a stream, nourishing his physical soul through his limbs and body.
